description: This file implements the SQL store for system properties in the Mattermost server, including methods for saving, updating, retrieving, and deleting system configuration data.

classes.name: SqlSystemStore
classes.description: Struct implementing the system properties storage with methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: newSqlSystemStore
methods.description: Constructor for SqlSystemStore, initializes the query builder.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts a new system property into the database.

methods.name: SaveOrUpdate
methods.description: Inserts or updates a system property, handling conflicts.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves all system properties as a map.

methods.name: GetWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves all system properties with a specific request context.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a system property by name.

methods.name: GetByNameWithContext
methods.description: Retrieves a system property by name with a specific request context.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteByName
methods.description: Deletes a system property by name permanently.

methods.name: InsertIfExists
methods.description: Inserts a system property if it does not exist, or returns the existing one.
